Portal sections

Manage Offered Services

Create, edit, or set durations and optional prices for services shown on your public booking page. Price can be left blank.

Daily Shifts & Operating Hours

Set individual day operating hours or create recurring outage time blocks.

Type a time or pick one. With no am or pm, 7–11 are morning, 12 is noon, and 1–6 are afternoon, so 9 is 9:00 AM and 5 is 5:00 PM. Type 6a for 6:00 AM, or 17:00 for 5:00 PM. The list follows your start-times interval.

Booking rules

These apply on your public booking page.

How often clients can start an appointment (for example 9:00, 9:30, 10:00). Service length stays the same.

Free time after each appointment before the next one can start. 15 minutes is the default when a business has not saved a break. None means the next visit can start as soon as the last one ends.

Clients cannot request a start time inside this window. New businesses are saved at 2 hours. A business with no saved setting keeps none.

Booking page

Shown at the top of your public page. Logo and cover are optional.

Linked to a map. Leave blank to hide it.

Logo optional

Drag a logo here, or choose a file. PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG. Up to 2 MB.

Drag the picture. The square is what visitors see. SVG files stay as they are.

Use an https link to an image. Leave blank to hide.

Special hours and time off

Tap a date to set custom hours or close that day. Drag across days, or hold a date and tap the last day, to mark time off. With a keyboard, use the arrow keys, then Enter. Shift plus the arrow keys selects a range.

Recurring Blocked Times & Outages

Automatically block out repeating windows like lunch breaks or staff syncs. Edit or remove a block from the list.

Vacation & Date Blocks

Block specific dates or ranges (e.g. Mar 10–17) without changing weekly hours. Optional all-day or time window. Edit or remove a block from the list.

Payment Processor Gateways

Enable or disable payment methods made available to clients during checkout.

Accept this deposit on

Checked methods collect the deposit. Unchecked methods stay available without one. If you have not saved this yet, it starts as the methods you already turned on. Pay at Appt does not take a deposit.

Clients can cancel earlier than this without a fee. The default is 24 hours.

Booking alerts

Off

Get a pop-up on this device when a booking comes in.

Email Booking Confirmations

Choose which emails Schedi sends your clients about their bookings, whether they book online or you add the booking yourself.

Send confirmation emails
Email the client after each successful booking
Allow recurring appointments
Let clients book weekly, biweekly, or monthly series on your public page. Pro only.
Send same-day reminder emails to clients
Sent the morning of the appointment. On by default.

In your business's time zone (Eastern Time unless your account uses another).

Send SMS confirmations and reminders
Texts go to the client phone on the booking. Requires Schedi SMS to be set up.

Emails come from Schedi. Client replies go to your Reply-to email, or to your owner email if that box is empty.

Clients

Your saved clients. Only you can see this list. Schedi never emails or texts clients you import.

Done visits are completed, or confirmed and already started. Pending, denied, no-shows, and cancellations are left out. Paid is what was collected, after refunds. Method uses the most-used paid method, or Pay at appt. A walk-in is saved as a walk-in, or has a visit added as a walk-in.
